quarterly_data.quarter: Kanto Denka Kogyo results briefing Q&A: FY2026 results briefing script with Q&A (05-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing, fiscal year ended March 2026): Director Niimi said the Shibukawa Plant fire and price-revision effects on some products roughly offset each other, so the JPY 54 hundred million operating profit is seen as the underlying earnings level; ROIC was 4.6%, improved year on year but short of the medium-term plan target of 8% or more. Operating margin was 8.4% and EBITDA margin 22.6%; group companies' net sales were JPY 415 hundred million (up JPY 26 hundred million). Capex fell to JPY 68 hundred million because investment in the China plant and large specialty-gas facilities has run its course.
quarterly_data.figure: ROIC 4.6%; operating margin 8.4%; EBITDA margin 22.6%; group companies' sales JPY 415 hundred million

quarterly_data.quarter: Kanto Denka Kogyo results briefing Q&A: FY2026 results briefing script with Q&A (05-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: President Hasegawa (results briefing, initial forecast for the year ending March 2027): net sales JPY 950 hundred million (up JPY 296 hundred million) and operating profit JPY 100 hundred million (up JPY 45 hundred million), assuming JPY 155 to the dollar. Specialty gases expect higher volume from expanding semiconductor demand and pass-through of higher raw material prices; battery materials expect higher volume and price revisions from new demand, centred on the US, driven by the shift away from China. Fine Chemicals sales JPY 818 hundred million with operating profit JPY 96 hundred million; non-consolidated specialty gases sales JPY 655 hundred million (up JPY 225 hundred million), mainly from price revisions plus higher volume as the company recovers share it lost because of the fire. Raw material and fuel prices (tungsten, lithium compounds) are a JPY 156 hundred million headwind. Investment JPY 64 hundred million; depreciation JPY 98 hundred million as the expanded KSG-14 and C4F6 facilities started last year run for a full year. The medium-term plan's JPY 1,000 hundred million sales target for the year is expected to be missed at JPY 950 hundred million: non-consolidated specialty gases at 124% of plan on memory demand led by generative AI and price pass-through, Fine Chemicals excluding specialty gases at 40%; Hasegawa said the company wants to exceed the plan but cannot promise it.
quarterly_data.figure: FY ending March 2027 forecast: net sales JPY 950 hundred million; operating profit JPY 100 hundred million; specialty gases (non-consolidated) sales JPY 655 hundred million; capex JPY 64 hundred million

quarterly_data.quarter: Kanto Denka Kogyo results briefing Q&A: FY2026 results briefing script with Q&A (05-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: President Hasegawa (results briefing Q&A): AI demand is above expectations - first HBM and DRAM, now logic and NAND flash too, with memory said to be short across the board. The tightest products are WF6 and C4F6. WF6: its raw material tungsten is concentrated in China, which has restricted exports; Kanto Denka has no disruption so far, including its raw-material inventory, but expects supply to become tight if the restrictions continue and is pushing recycled material and customer recycling. C4F6: instead of moving to cryogenic etching (for which the company developed KSG-22), customers want volume with today's technology, so C4F6 has become very tight; the company has added C4F6 capacity at its China plant and is preparing to decide on further expansion. Expanded C4F6, COS and KSG-14 capacity currently has headroom, and the company will judge from demand one to two years out whether urgent new capex is needed. KSG-14 volumes are rising sharply.

quarterly_data.quarter: Kanto Denka Kogyo results briefing Q&A: FY2026 results briefing script with Q&A (05-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: President Hasegawa (results briefing Q&A): the company is setting up a research facility in the US to bring in new technology for next-generation material gases; the site is almost decided but not yet announced, and it aims to send staff there by the end of this year. Producing existing gases in the US would be a very large investment and is being considered carefully; new gases would be produced in the US quickly as research results allow. Customers are asking the company to prepare thoroughly for a shift away from China, which is behind its consideration of new production or development sites in Europe and the US; its post-entry share has not been decided. The company projects the specialty gas market at JPY 3,600 hundred million in 2030, a conservative estimate in its view.
quarterly_data.figure: Specialty gas market projected at JPY 3,600 hundred million in 2030 (company estimate)

quarterly_data.quarter: Kanto Denka Kogyo results briefing Q&A: FY2026 results briefing script with Q&A (05-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Battery materials (results briefing): the LiPF6 capacity expansion is almost complete, but current orders can be met with the pre-expansion facilities, so President Hasegawa said the existing facilities will probably suffice this fiscal year and expects the expanded capacity to start up from next fiscal year, while noting battery demand forecasts could change. The new lithium-ion battery additive is in customer qualification and is planned to go on sale from the fourth quarter of the year ending March 2027, with almost no effect on this year's results. The lithium-ion battery recycling plant is scheduled for facility completion in October 2027. In the US, EV demand has dropped sharply since subsidies ended, but energy storage systems (ESS), centred on AI-related demand, have grown by more than EVs fell, supporting the company's battery-material market.
quarterly_data.figure: New additive sales from Q4 of the year ending March 2027; recycling plant completion October 2027

quarterly_data.quarter: Kanto Denka Kogyo results briefing Q&A: FY2026 results briefing script with Q&A (05-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Xuancheng KDK, the China plant (results briefing): because COVID pushed back the start of operations of both Phase I and Phase II, reducing the affiliate's net assets below the original assumption, the company booked a JPY 23 hundred million valuation loss on its investment in the affiliate in the non-consolidated accounts (eliminated in consolidation). For the year ending March 2027 the plant is expected to have sales of about JPY 40 hundred million and to turn profitable from the fourth quarter; besides locally produced C4F6, CF4 and WF6 it will widen its product range with Chinese partner plants and start selling to Japan and other Asian regions.
quarterly_data.figure: Xuancheng KDK sales about JPY 40 hundred million expected; valuation loss JPY 23 hundred million (non-consolidated)

quarterly_data.signal: Licensee Mexichem: President Hasegawa said the company licenses its LiPF6 manufacturing technology for the US and receives royalties as the project progresses, with little effect on this year's results and small technical-guidance fees for dispatched engineers; Mexichem's US plant is expected to be completed around the end of 2028, and the next large royalty income is expected from around early 2029.
